payload.docs_match:
KILLER — DOCS COMPLETE AND MATCHING THE ACTUAL SURFACE.

THE STRONGEST CLAIM I CAN MAKE HERE IS STRUCTURAL RATHER THAN DILIGENT: the two surfaces a session actually reads are PROJECTIONS of live state, not documents.
  The contract's lane list is generated from the served registry. It names all four tools this iteration added because they are served — not because I remembered to add them. The contract states the rule itself: it can never name a lane the surface does not serve. A hand-maintained list would have been wrong four separate times today.
  The handover is generated at boot from live iteration state. It cannot drift.

WHAT I EDITED BY HAND, and verified by re-reading rather than by trusting the patch: brand/voice.md now carries the Identifiers rule — expand every identifier in the message that uses it, prefer the plain phrase, an unexpanded id reads as precision and carries nothing.
  ACCEPTED COST, deliberate: voice.md is embedded in the contract, so the contract hash changed and every session re-attests. Correct price for a rule that must bind everyone instead of living in one agent's memory — which is where it was until tonight, and memory does not travel between machines.

THE MOST-READ DOCUMENTATION IN THE SYSTEM is now the evidence forms themselves. Every gate serves the review rubric in its field descriptions: a bless is not proof, cite a rubric not vibes, name the kill-criterion, log an override with its dissent. The agent cannot avoid reading it, which is the opposite of a method note it must go and find.

CHECKED FOR THE FAILURE THIS KILLER EXISTS TO CATCH — a surface still teaching the superseded way. One node had its conclusion reversed this iteration, and it was rewritten IN PLACE: a reader arriving at the old search decision is told immediately that it no longer holds, why it fell, and what of its analysis survives. Nothing else teaches a superseded mechanism.

ONE KNOWN MISMATCH, recorded rather than fixed silently: the guidance text inlined in each machine state describes guidance as something the state carries. That is TRUE TODAY. Under the design the owner ruled tonight it becomes the thing being replaced. Changing it now would document a mechanism that does not exist, so it stands, and the next iteration knows the surface is waiting.
payload.packaged:
VERSIONED, BASELINED, ENTRY SCRIPT IN PLACE.

THE ARTIFACT IS ALREADY LIVE rather than packaged for later. Six promotions landed this surface in trunk during the build, each verified green IN TRUNK before its commit: 6cfddf0 (216 passed), b91bc8e (220), c30f023 (221), 5adfe2b (222), dda426e (226). The promotion commits are the version record, and each names its files, its reason and its suite result — stronger for this purpose than a version number.

BASELINE CONFIGURATION: Node 22 or later; one runtime dependency, the packaged searcher, with twelve platform binaries in the lockfile and no install-time script; and version control, already a hard prerequisite. 226 checks green.

ENTRY SCRIPT: RUNME, unchanged, and it needed no change — it installs from the lockfile, and the lockfile carries the binary for every platform in scope. Verified rather than assumed: the binary resolves and executes here, and the Linux entries are present for the cloud targets.

DELETED THIS ITERATION: the hand-rolled searcher, entirely. Worth stating in the package evidence because a build that adds a dependency should say what it removed.
payload.dependencies_ruled:
THE SHIP REVIEW IS DONE AND THE STICKY RULINGS ARE HONOURED.

FOUR DEPENDENCIES DISPLAYED. Three carry standing rulings and are unchanged: the runtime, version control, and development-only type definitions.

ONE GENUINE FLIP: the packaged searcher. The prior standing ruling was zero-dependency; the owner overturned it at this iteration's kickoff — 'we overvalued zero dependency' — with one-click installability as the real constraint. This is that ruling's first exercise.

THE NEW ASK HAD NO STICKY RULING, so it was asked rather than inferred: is one-click installability a weight or a VETO? A veto disqualifies the chosen architecture outright.
  ANSWERED BY THE OWNER TODAY and recorded as a decision node with its platform list: a WEIGHT, and the risk scoped rather than accepted — three platforms in scope, exotic distributions explicitly out, and a failed install may simply tell the user what to install and stop.
  I note plainly that I had scored that criterion at maximum weight for two milestones WITHOUT its definition, and it decided the architecture. Asking earlier would have cost one message. That is logged as a risk entry, not smoothed over.

SHIPS UNFLAGGED. Nothing is forked, patched or privately pinned. NO UPSTREAM PROPOSALS OWED — checked against every surprise this iteration met, and each turned out to be correct behaviour we had assumed wrongly, now covered by a check on our side.
payload.handover_accepted:
KILLER — THE BLESS IS THE ACCEPTANCE. What is being accepted, stated plainly enough to be refused:

WHAT SHIPS, AND WORKS:
  A tool surface where the agent can reach any source — the working tree, any revision, the predecessor system, a shipped iteration's record — with context in one call, edit many places atomically, and be REFUSED rather than answered wrongly when it calls something badly.
  A machine whose every gate collects its own review: verify, validate, red-team, verdict, as required fields, injected at one place so a gate authored next year cannot miss them.
  A reopen that carries out a review's verdict — re-activating the cone, superseding rather than erasing, and leaving the path back intact.
  Engine promotion, so one agent's improvement to the shared judge reaches every agent, or none.
  226 checks green in trunk, and four properties moved from 'someone must remember' to 'the suite refuses'.

WHAT DOES NOT SHIP, and is accepted as not shipping:
  N3 — the rules that bind a step still do not reach the agent that walks it. The vision's own indictment stands. Ten notes and four laws minted today will reach no packet tomorrow. The owner has designed the successor in full and ruled it the next iteration.
  Three needs partial, one unexercised: the model-adherence check defers, the computed set is thin, and the record-survives-carelessness scenario was never staged.
  Two killer demonstrations incomplete: two agents have never run at once, and the guidance demonstration cannot be staged at all.

WHY THE HANDOVER IS ACCEPTABLE ANYWAY: everything unfinished is NAMED, OWNED and TRIGGERED in the register rather than discovered later, and nothing was built on an unmeasured assumption — the missing mechanism is absent, not guessed. An iteration that ships two-thirds of its ambition and can say exactly which third is missing is a better handover than one that ships all of it and cannot.

THE ONE THING I WOULD PUT IN FRONT OF ANY READER: for this project's entire history, gates were blessed without a single one of the four rounds their own method required — and every one of them passed. In this iteration every gate found something its author had missed, and two sent the work back. That difference is what is being accepted.
payload.verify_round:
BUILT IT RIGHT. Three input states since the last gate, each opened and read against its claim.

1. finalize_docs — read. Claims the projections match the surface. Verified the two claims that could be false: the contract's lane list was read at this session's boot and does name all four new tools; voice.md was re-read after the edit and does carry the Identifiers section. The claim that projections 'cannot drift' is structural rather than observed, and it is stated as such.

2. package — read. Claims six promotion commits with per-commit suite results, and an entry script needing no change. Verified against the promotion records and against the lockfile: twelve platform entries, each with its operating-system and architecture constraint, including the Linux ones the cloud targets need.

3. ship_review — read. Claims one flip, owner-ruled, and no upstream owed. Verified that the 'no upstream owed' conclusion was REACHED rather than skipped — it lists each surprise found in a consumed dependency and says why each is ours rather than theirs. An empty answer that shows its working is a conclusion; an empty answer alone is a skipped step.

4. THE SHIPPED SURFACE ITSELF — exercised rather than described. This gate's own milestone ran the killer demonstration live: a range read reporting 2586 total lines, a ref search into the predecessor system, and a record search into a closed iteration returning a file that exists in no working tree.

A BLESS IS NOT PROOF, and it matters most here because this is the last gate: gate_validation passed WITH OVERRIDES, and I have not quietly upgraded them. N3 is still recorded as unmet in the handover, in the gate whose bless ships the thing.
payload.validate_round:
BUILT THE RIGHT THING — against the frame, the vision and the register, for the last time.

AGAINST THE VISION, which is the fairest final measure. It named three failures: the lane cannot open the two documents the process requires; the most-used tool applies one edit per call; and four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet.
  TWO ARE FIXED AND DEMONSTRATED. The third is not. Two-thirds of the stated ambition, and the missing third is the one the vision called its own indictment.

WHAT IS MISSING: N3, and three partials on two causes — items being prose rather than nodes, and a scenario left unstaged.

WHAT IS WRONG: nothing outstanding. Two things were found wrong DURING this milestone and corrected rather than carried: the story walk's count of filled slides was optimistic and was corrected downward at the validation gate; and a risk entry I minted about the entry point overstated its case and was amended within minutes of the owner's clarification.

WHAT IS OUT OF SCOPE: nothing added at M9.

ASKS NO CHECK COVERED: none new. The three found earlier are consolidated into one register entry naming the pattern — the register is thorough about what the machine RECORDS and silent about what USING it is like.

AGAINST THE GOAL SYSTEM, final reading:
  G5, a review happens because something asks for it — MET, and it is the deliverable. Six gates, six findings, two reopens, one gate correcting the previous gate's account.
  G2, compute what can be computed — ADVANCED. Four properties crossed the line, and two of them were verified to catch defects their author had not foreseen.
  G4, the record survives carelessness — mechanically met, scenario unexercised.
  G1, the lane wins on merit — MIXED, and honestly worse before better: six scripts still written, five promotion refusals, two deadlocks.
  G3, every rule reaches the agent it binds — NOT MET. That is N3, and it is the next iteration.
payload.redteam_round:
THE OPPOSING CASE, in increasing strictness. Last gate, so it gets the hardest version.

FIRST: this ships with its headline requirement unbuilt. An iteration whose vision was 'rules should reach the agent' ends with rules not reaching the agent. Shipping it is declaring victory on the two easy thirds.
  REBUTTED ONLY IN PART. The two delivered thirds are not trivial — an unreadable design document and a one-edit-per-call tool were measured costs, and both are gone. But the objection lands: the hardest part is the part deferred, and deferring the hardest part is what every project does. What distinguishes this from the ordinary version is that the deferral is NAMED as the largest gap in four separate places, its mechanism is absent rather than guessed, and its successor is already designed and scoped. That is a deferral with a destination.

SECOND, STRICTER: the docs-match killer is satisfied largely because the surfaces are projections — which is a property of the system rather than work this iteration did. The one surface I hand-edited, I edited tonight, and I verified it myself. So the killer is passing on architecture plus self-verification, with no independent reader anywhere.
  TRUE, and unfixable inside this arrangement. The mitigation is narrow: projections are the STRONGER form of assurance, precisely because they remove the human step that drifts. A doc that cannot be wrong beats a doc someone checked.

THIRD, STRICTEST: this is the sixth self-blessed gate today on an iteration ABOUT whether self-blessed gates can be trusted. The answer this iteration produces is 'more than before, and still not independently'. Every finding was mine, every argument mine, every verdict mine. The rounds changed what I looked for; they cannot change who is looking.
  What I will not claim: that the rounds make self-blessing safe. What the evidence supports is narrower and worth stating exactly — six gates asked for four rounds, and six gates produced findings their author had missed, two of them serious enough to send work back. Before today, gates asked for none of it, and none of them ever found anything. That is a real difference and it is not the same as independence.

CITED RUBRIC: this gate's two killers — docs match the actual surface, and the bless is the acceptance — plus the register's pass lines and the vision's three named failures. The operative test at a release gate is whether what is being handed over is accurately described. It is: the handover names what does not ship as prominently as what does.

KILL-CRITERION for SHIPPING: that something in the handover is described as working when it is not. That is the only failure a release gate cannot survive. I hunted it by re-reading the handover against the validation gate's corrected counts rather than against the earlier optimistic ones, and by exercising the killer demonstration live rather than citing it. Not met.
SECOND KILL-CRITERION: that a doc still teaches a superseded mechanism. One decision was reversed this iteration; it was rewritten in place to say so. Checked. Not met.

HONEST WEAKNESS, stated one last time because it is the truest sentence about this iteration: every instrument that judged this work was built by the party being judged, and the owner's four interventions today — each of which changed something material — are the only independent input the whole run received.
payload.verdict:
PASS WITH NOTED OVERRIDES. SHIP.

THE OVERRIDES, carried forward from validation and NOT quietly upgraded:
  N3 is unmet — the rules that bind a step still do not reach the agent walking it. The vision's own indictment stands at the ship.
  Three needs partial on two causes; two killer demonstrations incomplete.
  Each is named in the handover with its owner and its trigger. Nothing unfinished is described as finished.

WHAT THE BLESS ACCEPTS:
  A tool surface that reaches any source and refuses rather than guessing — demonstrated live, three legs, no script.
  A machine whose every gate collects its own review, injected at one place so a gate authored later cannot miss it.
  A reopen that carries out a verdict, proven twice unstaged, and hardened by two silent deadlocks that it caused and that are now covered by a property generated over every state of the real machine.
  Engine promotion, so the shared judge is the same for every agent.
  226 checks green in trunk, four properties moved from memory to mechanism, and one module deleted.

WHAT IT DOES NOT ACCEPT AS DONE: the guidance join, which is the next iteration by the owner's ruling, already designed in full.

THE SENTENCE I WOULD LEAVE FOR WHOEVER READS THIS RECORD NEXT: for this project's entire history, every gate was blessed without a single one of the four rounds its own method required, and every one of them passed. Today six gates were asked, six found something their author had missed, and two sent the work back. The method did not change. The form did.
